sections.Profile:
"Old Coney Island!" was released by Game Plan in December 1979. This solid-state pinball machine was designed by Ed Cebula, with Roger Sharpe providing additional input. The artwork was crafted by Dick White, and the game was themed around the classic Coney Island amusement park, featuring elements like roller coasters and amusement rides. The game includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, a seven-bank drop target, and a spinning target.
